messages:
Lee Park: Opening a small PR to refresh the Guided Hello quickstart. Goals: move auth snippet to CLI-first example, keep env var example, tighten the minimal deploy steps, and fix two broken links.
Tara Singh: Thanks — can you add a brief note about env var precedence vs container secrets? New hires keep getting tripped by that.
Omar Reyes: Also note the default model alias changed recently (used to be `redwood/helium-v1`, now recommended `redwood/helium`). Might be worth a short migration note.
Lee Park: Yep — will add a migration callout. PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Current plan is to replace the one-line example `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` with the CLI example: ``redwood config set api-key <KEY>`` and show env fallback below.
Jenn (Docs): Quick UX ask — can we keep both the env and CLI examples but present them with a "Pick one" heading? New users like copy/paste, but platform engineers prefer the CLI.
docs-ci: Build started for PR 4823 — preview site will be available shortly.
Omar Reyes: Saw a broken anchor in the 'first-deploy' section earlier; link goes 404. I can attach the failing anchor id in a comment.
Lee Park: Thanks Omar, I patched the anchor and pushed a tiny fix. Also adding an alpine variant for the Docker snippet per policy feedback.
Tara Singh: FYI the Docker base in the original uses `node:18` which we've promised to avoid for customers with strict distro requirements — adding the slim/alpine example is good.
Jenn (Docs): Looks good — can someone check the wording around rate limits in the quickstart? It currently says "no rate limits" which is incorrect for free-tier.
Lee Park: Good catch, updated wording to "soft rate limits for free-tier; see pricing page" and added a link.
docs-ci: Build passed: docs-ci/preview/4823 ✅ (staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/guided-hello/preview)
Omar Reyes: Reviewed and left one nit about heading depth in the deploy section. Otherwise approving.
Lee Park: Awesome — merging once CI is green and the staging preview matches. Thanks all! :shipit:
